top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a new, mechanistically established chemical principle (catalytic, event-driven induced proximity via E3 recruitment and ternary-complex formation), reproduced by many groups for two decades. Crews and Deshaies supplied the PROTAC concept and 2001 proof of principle, and Handa's identification of cereblon as the thalidomide target explains an old drug and made the glue strand rational. P001 covers both entry routes; P002 is accurate for the PROTAC line but leaves the cereblon half of the principle unrecognised, so I rank it second, still well above no award.
